**Purpose:**
Tests the signature at early and resistant timepoints in targeted therapeutic and immune checkpoint inhibitor datasets

**Inputs:**
1. FOXD3 Gene Signatures
    Generated by: `01_bulkRNAseq_processing.RMD`

2. Tirosh et al. Gene Signatures
    Source: **insert source here**

3. Kwong et al. dataset - DESeq2 object
    Generated by: `01_bulkRNAseq_processing.RMD`

4. Hugo et al. dataset - DESeq2 object
    Generated by: `01_bulkRNAseq_processing.RMD`

    
**Manuscript Outputs:**
- Figure 3A-3F - gene signature validation across internal and external datasets

# Set up necessary background

## Libraries

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(DESeq2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggvenn)
  library(GSEABase)
  library(GSVA)
  library(here)
  library(limma)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(stringr)
  library(tidyverse)
})
```


## File Locations
```{r}
resultsDir1 <- here("data","data_objects")
resultsDir2 <- here("data","gene_sig")
resultsDir5 <- here("data","immune_test")

# Automatically create the folder on the computer if it doesn't exist
if (!dir.exists(resultsDir5)) {
  dir.create(resultsDir5, recursive = TRUE)
}

# Add location of counts files heres
# pathToCounts <- "C:/path/to/Counts"
pathToCounts <- "/Users/ctrou/Documents/PhD/FOXD3_Manuscript_Code/counts"
```

## Import the FOXD3 Gene Signature

```{r}

# use current generated gene sets
# geneSets <- getGmt(file.path(resultsDir2, "FOXD3_Sig.gmt"))
# geneSets_HUGO <- getGmt(file.path(resultsDir2, "FOXD3_Sig_HUGO.gmt"))

# use manuscript generated gene sets (previously run)
geneSets <- getGmt(file.path(here("gmt"), "241213_OE_Combined.gmt"))
geneSets_HUGO <- getGmt(file.path(here("gmt"), "241213_OE_Combined_HUGO.gmt"))
                        

# import Tirosh et al gene signatures
immune_ENSG <- getGmt(file.path(here("gmt"), "immune_ENSG.gmt"))
immune_HUGO <- getGmt(file.path(here("gmt"), "immune_HUGO.gmt"))
  
```

## Perform correlation analysis for Kwong et al.

```{r}
# import dds object
dds_kwong <- readRDS(file.path(resultsDir1, "dds_kwong.rds"))

# prep expression data
expPlusGSVA <- log2(dds_kwong[,2:40] + 1)
rownames(expPlusGSVA) = dds_kwong$Tags
expr_kwong <- new("ExpressionSet", exprs=as.matrix(expPlusGSVA))

# generate FOXD3 gene signature score
gbmPar_kwong <- gsvaParam(expr_kwong, geneSets, maxDiff=TRUE, kcdf = "Gaussian")
gsva_down_kwong <- gsva(gbmPar_kwong)

# generate Jerby-Arnon gene signature score
gbmPar_immue_kwong <- gsvaParam(expr_kwong, immune_ENSG, maxDiff=TRUE, kcdf = "Gaussian")
gsva_immune_kwong <- gsva(gbmPar_immue_kwong)


# generate hugo_data
kwong_data <- as.data.frame(t(rbind(gsva_down_kwong@assayData[["exprs"]], 
                                    gsva_immune_kwong@assayData[["exprs"]])))


kwong_data$Treatment <- sub("^.*_", "", rownames(kwong_data))


immune_to_print_kwong <- c("MDSC","MYELOID_DENDRITIC_CELL","PLASMACYTOID_DENDRITIC_CELL",
                     "CYTOTOXIC_CD8_T_CELL","MACROPHAGE","TREG")

file_names_kwong <- paste0("kwong_",immune_to_print_kwong,".png")

# generate kwong immune plots
kwong_plots<- list()
i = 1


# generate kwong immnune plots
for (immune in immune_to_print_kwong){
  kwong_plots[[i]] <- ggplot(kwong_data[kwong_data$Treatment=="On-Treatment",], 
                             aes(x = Downregulated, y = .data[[immune]])) +
    geom_point(size = 3, shape = 21, color = "black", fill = "black") + 
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE, color = "black") +
    stat_cor(method = "spearman",p.accuracy = 0.001, r.accuracy = 0.01) +
    ggtitle(paste0(immune," Kwong On-Treatment")) +
    theme_classic() + 
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 18), 
                                      axis.title = element_text(size = 15), 
                                      axis.title.y = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5), 
                                      axis.text = element_text(size = 11))
  
  i = i+1
}

# generate clean kwong immune plots for manuscript
kwong_plots_clean <- lapply(kwong_plots, function(p) {
    p +
        labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = NULL) +
        theme(
            plot.title = element_blank(),
            axis.title.x = element_blank(), # Removes "Time" from the bottom of every plot
            axis.title.y = element_blank(), # Removes "value" from the side of every plot
            axis.text.x = element_blank(),             # Removes X tick text
            axis.text.y = element_blank(),              # Removes Y tick text
            strip.background = element_blank(), # Removes those 'bars' if they came back
            strip.text = element_blank()
        )
})

# save kwong immune plots
for (i in seq_along(kwong_plots)) {
    ggsave(
        filename = file.path(resultsDir5, file_names_kwong[i]),
        plot = kwong_plots_clean[[i]],
        width = 4.8 ,
        height = 3,
        dpi = 300,
        scale = 1.2
    )
}
```
